title: Stale or inconsistent workflow text that will mislead implementers (small, mostly doc-only)
evidence: 03-workflows.md:193 'Agent drops PaneSummary-like detail first' (Snapshot has no PaneSummary; snapshot parts now exist, snapshot.proto:322-328, 02-contracts.md Snapshot parts); 03-workflows.md:325 and 03e-settings-and-drift.md:54 still cite a 'restore flag in HelloAck / 03g' that settings_epoch replaced (02-contracts.md Settings order); 02-contracts.md:297 lists capability goal.stop though StopGoal was removed (command.proto:42-48); snapshot.proto:354-356 says last_applied_command_seq 'HelloAck epoch tells the hub which epoch it belongs to', but at snapshot time the agent holds the previous epoch's value (Hello.last_epoch, agent.proto:154-155); 03b-usage-and-sync.md:165 reports probe skip 'with last_failure=INTERNAL and a message' but ProbeHealth (usage.proto:93-110) has no message field and counting a skip as a failure feeds the failover threshold (03b:51-54); 03b-usage-and-sync.md:52-54 says StopProbe is 'delivered when it returns' although not_after is 10 min (02-contracts.md Deadlines), and the W1 reconcile (03-workflows.md:125-133) only adds missing EnsureProbe, never StopProbe for a probe the snapshot shows but the hub no longer assigns; HelloAck.settings_generation is documented fleet-wide (agent.proto:184-186) while 03e:50-52 makes Settings.generation per machine, causing a harmless but needless resend to every machine; GoalState.watch_alive drives WAITING->STUCK (03c-goals.md:265) but is not in the fingerprint (03c-goals.md:279-280) and nothing says a flip must emit a new GoalState event.
problem: Contract text and workflow text disagree in these places; none changes a proto except the optional ProbeHealth message.
fix: Doc fixes: remove the trim sentence; replace restore-flag references with settings_epoch; drop goal.stop; reword last_applied_command_seq to 'belongs to Hello.last_epoch'; state that probe skips do not increment consecutive_failures (optional ProbeHealth.message); add the reverse probe diff (snapshot probe with no hub assignment -> StopProbe) and a longer StopProbe not_after; say a watch_alive flip emits a GoalState event.
verify: Confirmed doc drift, no proto blocker. 03-workflows.md:193 still says the agent 'drops PaneSummary-like detail first' and logs snapshot.trimmed (Snapshot has no PaneSummary; parts exist, 02-contracts.md:~225). 03-workflows.md:325 and 03e-settings-and-drift.md:54-55 still cite a HelloAck restore flag, which 02-contracts.md:233-237 says settings_epoch replaced. 02-contracts.md:297 lists capability goal.stop though StopGoal was removed (status.proto:~137 reserves 303). snapshot.proto:354-356 says HelloAck epoch tells the hub the epoch of last_applied_command_seq, but at snapshot time that value belongs to the previous epoch (Hello.last_epoch). 03b-usage-and-sync.md:165 reports a probe skip as last_failure=INTERNAL 'and a message', but ProbeHealth (usage.proto:93-110) has no message field, and counting skips as failures feeds the 3-failure failover. 03b:52-54 says StopProbe is 'delivered when it returns', but the default not_after is 10 min (02-contracts.md:~200), and the W1 reconcile (03-workflows.md:125-133) only adds missing EnsureProbe, never StopProbe for an unassigned probe. watch_alive (snapshot.proto:205) drives WAITING->STUCK (03c:265) but is not in the fingerprint (03c:279-280). The HelloAck.settings_generation per-machine versus fleet-wide mismatch is not verified.
resolution: Doc and comment fixes: 03-workflows (snapshot parts instead of a trim, settings_epoch instead of a restore flag, reverse StopProbe diff in W1), 03b (probe skip is not a failure, StopProbe 24 h plus reconcile), 03c (watch_alive in the fingerprint and its own GoalState event), 03e and agent.proto (HelloAck.settings_generation is per machine, epoch compare), snapshot.proto (last_applied_command_seq belongs to Hello.last_epoch), 02-contracts (StopProbe deadline). Added optional ProbeHealth.message (usage.proto); goal.stop was already removed by an earlier theme. Rules recorded in ADR 0019 decision 33.

title: Specs still describe superseded designs (log files, owner strings, SUPPORTED-only dispatch, goal.stop)
evidence: docs/specs/03d-triage-sessions-logs.md:257-346 (W9 diagram `hub files`, `<session>/<stream>/<day>.zst`, `log_segments`, Persistence table row `Log files: one per (session, stream, day)`) and 03f-hub-internals.md:63,110 contradict ADR 0015:23-36 (chunks as rows in logs.db, one transaction per batch). 03d:146-147,192 still show `owner` on EnsureSession/sessions although agent/v1/command_tmux.proto:76-78 reserves `owner` (now owner_principal). 03c-goals.md:63-64 requires `version_support = SUPPORTED` for dispatch, but ADR 0018:91-98, 02-contracts.md:350-354, 03b-usage-and-sync.md:46 and 03e:210-213 let UNVERIFIED_PARSING dispatch while usage and ready parse live. 02-contracts.md:297 lists capability `goal.stop` although StopGoal was removed (:469-473, command.proto:42-48). ADR 0018:70 says `expires_at` where triage.proto:191 and 02b:183 use `expire_time`.
problem: An implementer reading 03d W9 builds the file-per-day store the owner already replaced, and one reading 03c rule 3 stops auto-dispatch after every harness auto-update, which ADR 0018 exists to prevent. The `goal.stop` capability has no command behind it, against the README rule that a capability without a message is removed.
fix: One doc-only edit pass before development: rewrite 03d W9 diagram, rules and persistence rows (and 03f:63,110) for logs.db and the pane-summary archive. Replace owner with owner_principal in W8. Change 03c:64 to the 03b wording (SUPPORTED or UNVERIFIED_PARSING with usage and ready parsing live). Delete goal.stop from 02-contracts.md:297. Fix ADR 0018:70 to expire_time and update README.
verify: Confirmed on each point. 03d:249,257,263,314 still describe 'hub files' and <session>/<stream>/<day>.zst with a log_segments index, while ADR 0015:23-36 stores chunks as rows in logs.db. 03f:63,110 still use log_segments and the old model. 03d:146-147,192 show 'owner', which agent command_tmux.proto reserves in favour of owner_principal. 03c:64 requires version_support = SUPPORTED, while ADR 0018:91-98 and 03b:45 let UNVERIFIED_PARSING dispatch. 02-contracts.md:297 lists goal.stop though StopGoal was removed (command.proto:42). ADR 0018:70 says expires_at, while the field is expire_time. README.md:9-10 says four views and omits OpenCode. Impact is real for 03d W9 and 03c rule 3 (behavior), minor for the rest.
resolution: 03d W9 rewritten for logs.db (no files, log_chunks rows, own writer) with 03f (logWriter, data model rows, indexes), 03-workflows vocabulary, 03g Q6 and log_store.proto comment updated; W8 uses owner_principal and the TriageItem fields; 03c rule 3 and goal.stop were already fixed by themes C to E; root README now lists six views and OpenCode. The sweep of backticked names in specs, ADRs 0014-0019 and the mockup README also fixed `_at` names, ResetTime.at, StartGoalRequest.dispatch_reason and nested spec names, and mockup EnsureSession owner. ADR 0018 is not edited: its stale names (expires_at and others) are corrected in a new ADR 0019 note (decision 34).
